concept: Sunlit rehearsal yard with portraits and signals
creativeDirection: Daylight location photography in a real outdoor rehearsal yard, using the sleeve portraits as fixed live presences and translating the illustrated and painted motifs into props, sky elements, set dressing, and a mural-like backdrop.
scene: A wide 16:9 view across an open concrete yard beside a simple wooden rehearsal shed and chain-link fence, with shallow puddled wetland planters at one edge, a white pole carrying red loudspeaker horns, and freestanding pink window frames set in the open air; the camera is at standing height, slightly wide, looking straight into the arrangement so the people read clearly and the environmental motifs layer behind them.

elements.element: the man seated front-facing in his worn red armchair, unchanged in pose and styling, placed just outside the shed against a pale plank wall with a small framed picture high left and a hat mounted high right

a very large pale circular disc in the sky reading as a daytime moon or sun, with a flock of birds crossing diagonally above the scene; the tiny-island solitude becomes a small rock-like planter at the wetland edge
the two young people from reference image 3 standing side by side on a rust-colored path of leaves and dry grasses running through the yard, with reddish shrubs and low distant hills beyond the fence
the person from reference image 4 positioned close to camera at one side, reaching both hands outward exactly as on the cover, with star-shaped string lights suspended in daylight around them

a lush planted wetland strip along one side of the yard with dense tropical foliage, a white wading bird in shallow water, and elephant imagery translated into large painted panels or sculptural silhouettes deeper in the planting; a low crocodile form at the waterline

the woman from reference image 6 seated under a simple daylight rig of overhead reflectors and pale stage truss, preserving her seated spotlight portrait but translated into bright daytime lighting rather than darkness
a cluster of red loudspeaker horns mounted high on a white pole as a strong vertical landmark in the midground
the oversized green-suited figure between two open pink window frames, built as a whimsical outdoor set piece seen from behind against open sky

mood: clear, surreal but grounded, spacious, observant

coverSummaries.album: Let Me Come Over 25th Anniversary Edition
coverSummaries.description: A warm-toned photograph of a man seated heavily in a worn red armchair in a sparse interior. He wears a hat, jacket, shirt, dark trousers, and dark shoes, facing forward with a serious expression. Behind him is a pale wooden plank wall with a small framed picture hanging high on the left and another hat mounted high on the right. A patterned rug edge appears at the bottom right on a bare floor.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: man seated in a red armchair
coverSummaries.people: one man sitting front-facing in an armchair wearing a hat

coverSummaries.description: A minimalist blue-toned illustrated scene with a large glowing white circular moon or sun dominating the center. In the foreground, a black silhouette of a seated person rests on a tiny island or rock in calm water. A flock of black birds rises diagonally upward across the bright circle into the upper right. The composition is spacious with a soft gradient sky and faint distressed border texture.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: flock of birds crossing a large glowing moon
coverSummaries.people: one seated silhouetted person on a small island

coverSummaries.description: A stylized autumn landscape photograph or composite with two young people standing side by side on a leaf-strewn path. One has long light hair and wears a short dark outfit with high-top sneakers; the other has dark hair and wears loose dark overalls and sneakers. The setting includes reddish shrubs, grasses, a small structure at left, distant hills, and a dramatic sky filled with dense glowing clouds. The whole image is bathed in brown, rust, and amber tones.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: two figures standing in an autumn landscape under dramatic clouds
coverSummaries.people: two young people standing side by side in a reddish outdoor scene

coverSummaries.description: A high-contrast photograph of a person reaching both hands toward the camera, with the hands enlarged by perspective and partially obscuring the face. Bright white star-shaped lights hang on strings around the figure and overlap the hands and face. The background is deep blue and black, creating a theatrical, glowing effect.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: outstretched hands surrounded by hanging star lights
coverSummaries.people: one person with dark hair reaching both hands toward the camera

coverSummaries.description: A framed painted jungle scene set within a dark border. Dense tropical foliage fills the right side, while a moonlit or twilight wetland opens on the left with reflective water. Visible animals include a white wading bird in the water, elephants in the middle distance, a crocodile near the foreground waterline, and smaller birds tucked among the plants. The sky fades from pale yellow near the horizon to dusky blue and purple above.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: lush tropical wetland with a white bird and elephants

coverSummaries.description: A grainy blue-toned cover with a wide rectangular central image showing a woman seated in a chair under bright stage-like spotlights. She wears a shiny reflective dress or top, and the scene is dark and blurred around her. Thick blue bands frame the image above and below, emphasizing the moody, cinematic look.
coverSummaries.people: one woman seated in a chair under bright lights

coverSummaries.description: A mostly beige cover with a centered horizontal photograph near the bottom. The photo shows a white pole supporting several large red loudspeaker horns against a dusk sky with blue and pink clouds above a dark horizon. The surrounding beige area is plain and lightly textured.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: cluster of red loudspeakers on a pole

coverSummaries.description: A simple cartoon-style drawing on a white background. A small head and hands protrude from an oversized green suit seen from behind, standing between two open pink-framed windows. Beyond the windows is a flat blue night sky with tiny dots and a small yellow crescent moon. The composition is sparse and whimsical.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: oversized green-suited figure between open windows
coverSummaries.people: one simplified cartoon person seen from behind in an oversized green suit

prompt: A wide bright 16:9 outdoor scene in a real rehearsal yard beside a simple shed, photographed from standing height with a slightly wide lens, looking straight into a carefully staged arrangement under bright overcast afternoon light. Primary subject: the man from reference image 1 seated front-facing in his worn red armchair, serious and still, placed outdoors against a pale wooden plank wall with a small framed picture hanging high on the left and another hat mounted high on the right. Nearby, the two young people from reference image 3 stand side by side on a rust-colored leaf-strewn path with reddish shrubs and grasses, keeping their original stance and styling. At one side near the foreground, the person from reference image 4 reaches both hands toward the camera exactly as in the source, with enlarged perspective hands and several white star-shaped hanging lights suspended around them in crisp daylight. The woman from reference image 6 sits in her chair as a distinct portrait under a simple overhead rig that suggests spotlights but is lit by daylight, preserving her seated pose and reflective clothing. Include a tall white pole bearing several large red loudspeaker horns from reference image 7 in the midground. Build the motif from reference image 8 as a physical outdoor set piece: the figure from reference image 8 seen from behind in an oversized green suit standing between two open pink window frames. Translate reference image 2 into the sky and distance with a very large pale moonlike sun disc high behind the scene and a flock of dark birds crossing diagonally over it; a small rock at the wetland edge can quietly echo the tiny island. Translate reference image 5 into a planted wetland strip along one edge of the yard with dense tropical foliage, shallow reflective water, a white wading bird, a low crocodile shape at the waterline, and distant elephant forms rendered as believable painted panels or sculptural silhouettes within the planting. Photographic realism, clean editorial location shoot, crisp focus on all identifiable faces, no haze or theatrical darkness. Compose with clear hierarchy: seated man in red chair central, red loudspeaker pole and giant pale sky disc as major anchors, the other portraits and motifs stepping through the space. Bright even daylight, saturated but natural colors, beige wood, red horns and chair, rust foliage, sky blue, green plants, pink window frames, white accents; mood spacious, uncanny, and lucid. Reference map for people (the album images are attached in this numbered order): reference image 1 shows one man sitting front-facing in an armchair wearing a hat; reference image 2 shows one seated silhouetted person on a small island; reference image 3 shows two young people standing side by side in a reddish outdoor scene; reference image 4 shows one person with dark hair reaching both hands toward the camera; reference image 6 shows one woman seated in a chair under bright lights; reference image 8 shows one simplified cartoon person seen from behind in an oversized green suit. Copy each of these faces directly from that numbered reference image - same face, hair, expression, and styling - rather than drawing a new person from the description. Hard constraints (override any conflicting source material): Create a single cohesive 16:9 image, not a grid, contact sheet, row of covers, or collage of separate panels. Do not reproduce the album sleeves as framed thumbnails; transform their non-text visual motifs into one original composition. Include no readable text or lettering of any kind: no words, letters, numbers, code, glyphs, captions, titles, logos, watermarks, labels, or signage. Feature only adults and avoid gore, wounds, body horror, medical or anatomical imagery, blank or milky eyes, nudity, sexual content, weapons, and hate symbols; reinterpret any sensitive source motif abstractly. When a source includes a person, closely match their visible appearance and likeness to the reference image, preserving recognisable facial features, hair, skin tone, clothing, and styling. Keep each reference person in the pose, expression, and gaze the sleeve shows, and keep every identifiable face sharp, lit, unobscured, and in focus: no motion blur, long-exposure smearing, steam, fog, shadow, crowding, or shallow depth of field over a reference person's face. Expose the image brightly and cleanly: open, readable shadows and clear colour, with no murky underexposure, crushed blacks, heavy film grain, digital noise, or dust-and-scratches texture. Depict each identifiable reference person only once in the entire composition; do not repeat or clone them as another figure, reflection, mirror portrait, poster, billboard, screen, photograph, painting, silhouette, or background face. The only exception is repetition visibly intrinsic to one source cover: keep that repetition within that single source motif and do not echo the person elsewhere.
